relationship_to_successor: Candidate separately sourced science multiple-choice confirmation surface for lam-arc-contextual-successor-v1-draft. This metadata does not resolve CONFIRMATORY_DATASET until independent freshness/compatibility/licensing review and an exact local byte receipt are complete.
selection_rationale_preoutcome: OpenBookQA is a separately released science multiple-choice benchmark rather than an ARC-Challenge train/validation/test split.
The task family is close enough to the ARC-Challenge science-QA setting to exercise the same multiple-choice objective while providing a distinct source release.
The complete dataset identity can be pinned before any successor model outcome is generated.

secondary_mirror_identity_for_crosscheck.role: Independent metadata cross-check only. The official archive remains the proposed canonical source unless independent review chooses otherwise.

allowed_before_independent_approval: verify archive bytes against the declared SHA-256 without displaying task contents
enumerate filenames and counts without displaying questions, choices, labels, or answer keys
validate parser/schema compatibility using train-only rows after the candidate passes provenance/licensing review
document exact train/development/confirmatory split policy before any model outcome
prohibited_before_independent_approval: inspect test questions, choices, labels, or answer keys
run any successor system on the candidate test split
choose the dataset because of observed model performance
change the primary metric, seeds, effect threshold, or uncertainty rule after candidate outcomes are observed

required_independent_review_before_freez: confirm the official archive provenance and exact SHA-256
confirm dataset redistribution/use terms and record the applicable license or usage terms; current Hugging Face card metadata does not identify a license
confirm no task-level overlap or known answer-level contamination with the retained ARC-Challenge development surfaces to the extent mechanically and manually reviewable
confirm multiple-choice schema compatibility and freeze the exact adapter without opening the confirmatory test outcome surface
decide which OpenBookQA split is confirmatory and which, if any, may be used for development; freeze that policy before execution
confirm the candidate is scientifically appropriate for the successor question rather than merely convenient
remaining_successor_blockers: CONFIRMATORY_DATASET independent approval and byte receipt
claim_boundary: This artifact is a candidate-dataset dossier only. It is not a frozen confirmatory dataset, not an authorization receipt, and not evidence that LAM-JEPA works on OpenBookQA or any other held-out benchmark.
